name: Awei H15 Smart Watch man IP67 Waterproof sports watch
description:
Awei H15 Smart Watch – Health, Fitness, and Connectivity on Your Wrist

Stay connected and track your health effortlessly with the Awei H15 Smart Watch, combining style, functionality, and durability in one sleek wearable.

Key Features:

HD Full-Touch Display: 1.69-inch vibrant screen offers clear visuals and easy navigation.

Comprehensive Health Tracking: Monitor heart rate, SpO₂, sleep patterns, and daily activity for a healthier lifestyle.

Sports & Fitness Modes: Multiple workout modes accurately track your activities, whether walking, running, cycling, or more.

Smart Notifications: Receive calls, messages, and app alerts directly on your wrist, keeping you in touch on the go.

Long Battery Life: Efficient battery lasts 7–10 days on a single charge, minimizing downtime.

Water Resistant (IP67): Splash and sweat-proof design, perfect for workouts and daily use.

Specifications:

Brand: Awei

Model: H15

Display: 1.69-inch HD color touch screen

Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.0

Sensors: Heart rate, SpO₂, pedometer, sleep monitor

Sports Modes: Multiple workout options

Battery Capacity: ~200–250 mAh, up to 7–10 days usage

Compatibility: Android & iOS

Notifications: Calls, SMS, app alerts

Design: Lightweight, ergonomic strap with stylish finish

Elevate your fitness, monitor your health, and stay connected with the Awei H15 Smart Watch—where technology meets convenience.
